milestone.title: mp watch end-to-end against herdr 0.7.x — harness defaults, spawn API realignment, spawn diagnostics, watch readiness parity

intent.outcome: mp watch successfully drives a milestone execute → complete against the current stable herdr (0.7.x) end-to-end. Harness config has sensible defaults; herdr spawn API is realigned to current stable herdr; spawn failures are loud in log, status, and exit code; mp doctor and execution check reflect real watch readiness (harness config + herdr CLI compatibility).

problem.description: From mp-watch-issues.md (andre dogfood, 2026-07-23) — five issues make mp watch unusable end-to-end against herdr 0.7.5: (A) no default agent runner/coordinator harness config (mp watch refuses on a fresh project); (B, hard blocker) herdr argv mismatch — mp emits `herdr agent start role-runner-1 --cwd <path> -- opencode` but herdr 0.7.5 wants `agent start <NAME> --kind <KIND> --pane <ID> [OPTIONS]` (mp treats herdr as create-labeled-agent + cwd, herdr wants start-known-kind-in-existing-pane); (C) silent spawn failure — log shows boot → state_persisted → read_milestone → ensure_pane only, no stderr, no exit code, run_state goes stale; (E) mp execution check / handoff reports ready while watch preconditions are red. The existing M149 (watch automation, complete) was built against a different herdr API and has drifted. No open milestone covers the herdr-0.7.x realignment or the diagnostics gap. (Issue D — verify-ac `unknown` noise — is already addressed by completed M177, verification gate hardening.) The desired outcome for the next mp release per the report: spawn succeeds against current stable herdr; spawn failures are loud; doctor/execution check reflect real watch readiness.

in_scope: Default agent harness config: when only one harness skill is installed (or on first project setup), auto-set agent.runner.harness and agent.coordinator.harness to the available one; surface the decision in mp doctor; fold the harness config check into execution handoff so handoff does not look ready while watch cannot start.

herdr spawn API realignment: update mp watch herdr integration to herdr 0.7.x shape — create/ensure the runner pane via herdr pane APIs (workspace/tab/pane), then `herdr agent start <name> --kind opencode --pane <id>` (cwd as a pane property if herdr 0.7.x models it that way). Verify against the current stable herdr release.

Version gate: mp doctor and watch preconditions check the herdr CLI shape (e.g. `herdr agent start --help` contains the expected flags); fail fast with a clear `mp X requires herdr >= Y` message instead of a silent crash after boot.

Spawn diagnostics: on any herdr command failure, append a structured watch.log event capturing full argv, stdout, stderr, and exit status; set run_state to a terminal failure kind (distinct from `stale`); exit non-zero from the foreground watch driver when spawn fails.

Watch readiness parity: fold watch preconditions (harness config + herdr CLI compat) into mp execution check / execution handoff so the readiness signal reflects real watch spawnability (or explicitly document two readiness surfaces if folding is rejected).
out_of_scope: M149 is not reopened for re-derivation; this milestone builds on M149 and adds the herdr-0.7.x realignment + diagnostics + readiness parity.

Issue D (verify-ac `unknown` noise) — already addressed by completed M177 (verification gate hardening). No new work here unless M177's heuristic misses the specific prose forms seen in andre M01 (Q-01 to confirm during execution).
Fixing andre M01 S3 — separate; per the report's non-goals, will run manually or after the watch fix lands.
Changing herdr itself or shipping a legacy herdr pin — file separately against the herdr project if needed; mp adapts to current stable herdr.

acceptance_criteria.description: Default harness config: on a fresh project with exactly one installed harness skill, mp watch preconditions either auto-configure agent.runner.harness / agent.coordinator.harness or mp doctor surfaces the missing config and a one-liner to set it.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — fresh-project fixture (mp init, one harness installed) reaches mp watch preconditions green or doctor surfaces the exact missing-config command.

acceptance_criteria.description: herdr CLI version gate: mp doctor (and mp watch preconditions) detect herdr CLI shape and fail fast with `mp X requires herdr >= Y` on mismatch, instead of crashing mid-spawn.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — doctor against an incompatible herdr (or a stubbed older shape) prints the version-gate message and exits non-zero with no spawn attempt.

acceptance_criteria.description: End-to-end spawn: live mp watch against the current stable herdr (0.7.x) successfully creates the opencode runner pane and progresses past ensure_pane to a persisted state.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — mp watch <id> against current stable herdr reaches state_persisted past ensure_pane (no silent exit); watch.log shows the pane-create and agent-start events.

acceptance_criteria.description: Spawn diagnostics: on a forced herdr spawn failure (e.g. invalid harness kind), watch.log captures argv + stdout + stderr + exit code as a structured event; watch-control status shows a terminal failure kind (not `stale`); foreground watch exits non-zero.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — forced-failure repro produces a structured spawn_error event in watch.log, a terminal failure state (not stale), and a non-zero foreground exit.

acceptance_criteria.description: Watch readiness parity: mp execution check / execution handoff reflects real watch readiness — harness config and herdr CLI compatibility are part of the readiness gate (or two readiness surfaces are explicitly documented).
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — readiness surfaces name watch preconditions, not only execution-mode readiness

design_decisions.choice: Realign mp to current stable herdr (0.7.x pane-create then agent start --kind --pane). Do not ship or pin a legacy herdr version; do not add an mp compat shim that re-emits the old argv.
design_decisions.rationale: Adapting to the current upstream API is the forward-looking choice; pinning a legacy herdr version couples the mp release to a stale binary and the compat shim path perpetuates the drift. Matches the report's primary suggestion.

design_decisions.choice: Auto-set agent.runner.harness and agent.coordinator.harness from the single installed harness skill on first use (or via mp init); surface the auto-set in mp doctor; include the harness config check in execution handoff so handoff cannot look ready while watch cannot start.
design_decisions.rationale: Silent assumption is dangerous; explicit-but-automatic (surface in doctor) reduces friction on fresh projects while keeping the operator informed. Folding the check into handoff closes the execution-check vs watch readiness gap (Issue E).

design_decisions.choice: Introduce a run_state kind for terminal spawn failure (distinct from stale); capture a structured spawn_error event in watch.log with argv + stdout + stderr + exit; foreground watch exits non-zero on spawn failure.
design_decisions.rationale: The current stale state and silent exit hide the real failure (Issue C); a distinct terminal kind + structured event + non-zero exit makes the failure actionable. Matches the report's suggestion.

design_decisions.choice: Fold harness config and herdr CLI compat into mp execution check / execution handoff so a single readiness signal reflects real watch spawnability (preferred). Fallback: explicitly document two surfaces (execution handoff vs watch) if folding is rejected.
design_decisions.rationale: A single readiness signal avoids the can_handoff:true / watch:red confusion (Issue E). Documentation alone is weaker than a single gate; folding is the stronger fix.

open_questions.question: Does M177 (verification gate hardening, complete) catch the specific prose forms that produced `unknown` in the andre M01 AC verification report, or does M01's AC data predate M177's enforcement? Confirm during execution; if M177 misses these forms, extend its prose-detection heuristic.
open_questions.answer: Resolved: M177 prose-detection coverage for andre M01 AC forms is verified during execution via AC-03 end-to-end. If M177 misses andre M01 specific prose forms, extend the heuristic within M197 (fold into scope as a fallback). Otherwise M177 already covers; no new work.

open_questions.question: In herdr 0.7.x, is the runner working directory a pane property or an agent-start flag? Confirm by reading the herdr pane-create APIs during execution; affects the realigned spawn sequence.
open_questions.answer: Implementation detail, confirmed during execution by reading herdr 0.7.x pane APIs. The realigned spawn sequence (D1) accommodates cwd as a pane property (set during pane create) or via a follow-up pane set-cwd command, whichever herdr 0.7.x exposes. Not a design fork.
